product_js.title: Custom Patriotic Semi Truck with Waving American Flag Comforter
product_js.description:
Transform your bedroom with this custom trucker comforter set from Jeminise, designed for those who live life on the road. Featuring a patriotic semi truck design with a waving American flag, stars, and stripes, this bedding set brings a modern and stylish look to your decor. Perfect as a thoughtful gift for truckers and families, it offers a soft, cozy, and lightweight feel for comfortable sleep in any season.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features a customizable text input field so you can personalize your trucker bedding with a name.
  • Cozy & Lightweight Comfort: Made from soft brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Vibrant Digital Printing: High-definition digital printing ensures colors stay bright and vibrant without fading over time.
  • Included Components: The set includes 1 duvet cover or comforter, with options to add matching pillowcases or a flat sheet.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, air dry or tumble dry on low heat for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Fabric Type Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber

Theme Trucker, Patriotic
Pattern Cartoon

Seasons All
